text_block_list.text: I'm walking down the hallway one day when I hear Fuji Kiseki's voice echoing out from the dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!
I don't want to bother her while she's in the zone, so I wait quietly by the door for her to finish.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Seven, eight!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I knew it. That last section is lacking refinement…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. I didn't know you were here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is perfect, though. There's something I want to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, I wanted to ask if I should try to push myself to my limits or pursue a more tranquil performance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Specifically, I'm torn between wowing people with dynamic choreography or entrancing them with a performance harmonious in both song and dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Both have their own merits, so I'm not sure which to choose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If it were you, would you aim to create a sensational dance or a more balanced performance?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That makes sense. Anyone would be intrigued by moves they've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And of course, every performer worth their salt must possess an indelible brilliance that dazzles all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I know exactly what to do now. I'm going to steal everyone's breath with a truly phenomenal dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And to achieve that, I must push myself to greater heights and make my moves faster, higher, and sharper!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!
She lets out a battle cry and begins dancing with the finesse of a professional. There's no doubt she's one of the best dancers in the whole school.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. If I'm going to watch something, I'd want it to be an undeniably flawless show.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right. I'll have to perfect my every move for this. Even the slightest misstep can disrupt the balance of a performance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't want to disappoint my adoring ponies now! ♪
She diligently adjusts her movements. It surely won't be long before her performance is polished to perfection.
